subject: Next steps: PR path & supplier onboarding options for ACME (Ariba/Coupa)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@acme-corp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & procurement path options (PR vs card / marketplace)

Sara — thanks again for your time earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so your procurement team can evaluate the commercial path.

Recap (topline)
- ACME use-case: customer support embeddings + reranking; expected monthly tokens ~8–12M.
- Preferred model/throughput target: latencies <150ms for 1k concurrent sessions.
- Procurement signal from your side: leaning toward Purchase Requisition (PR) / PO vs corporate card for predictable spend.
- Procurement systems mentioned: Ariba (primary) and a potential marketplace (Coupa) if Redwood is pre-approved.

Open procurement questions we flagged
- Will ACME create a one-time PR/PO referencing Redwood, or do you prefer Redwood to be added as a supplier in Ariba first?
- Do you need a vendor packet (W-9, bank details, vendor form) and a Redwood supplier ID to expedite PR?
- Marketplace preference: if ACME already buys via Coupa, is getting onto your catalog faster than direct supplier onboarding?

Proposed next steps (what I can do)
1) Send an internal PR playbook and checklist that maps out steps for both Ariba and Coupa (I attached a short mutual action plan).
2) If you want the PR route: please advise the procurement contact who will create the PR/PO and the required vendor fields (tax id, address, contact email).
3) If ACME wants marketplace (Coupa), let me know the catalog contact — we can request Redwood be added; marketplaces sometimes speed purchase without a full vendor setup.
4) I will loop in our Sales Ops (Ben) to create an internal ticket to collect vendor onboarding docs and to track the PR creation.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.pdf (summary + checklist)

Next step ask: can you confirm which procurement path you prefer (Ariba supplier setup vs PR referencing a vendor already in your system vs Coupa marketplace)? Also — can you share the procurement team email if different from procurement@acme-corp.com?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the thread — useful detail. Ben, can you please open a Sales Ops ticket to track vendor onboarding for ACME and outline the exact artifacts we need to hand to their procurement team? Include the timeline so we can commit back to ACME (they want the PR created this week).

Checklist to include in the ticket (from Jasmine / procurement):
- W-9 (US tax form)
- Bank remit instructions (ACH)
- Certificate of insurance (COI)
- Redwood legal vendor name + remit address + tax id
- Preferred billing cadence and contact for invoicing

Also please check internally whether Redwood already has a Coupa supplier ID that ACME could reference — if so that could accelerate to a PO without full Ariba setup.

Ben — please reply with the new ticket ID and a short link to the ops ticket.

Quote from Sara: 
> Our procurement team typically prefers PR/PO for new vendors. We run onboarding in Ariba unless the vendor is already available in Coupa (we do use both).

Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
